Question Choices: A bowl contains 3 candies and 2 cockroaches. Drawn cockroaches are replaced before the next draw. Let X be the draw on which the first candy is picked. Find P(X ≤ 2), the probability that a candy appears within the first two draws.
Hints: P(X ≤ 2)=1-P(X>2);P(X>2)=(2/5)^2 since both draws must be cockroaches
